description: Business Health on one day for one business: Control Health and each of the six questions' score and state, as the screen worked them out (command_center.health), and the Executive Summary's vital signs that day (vitals). The latest of the day replaces the earlier one; kept about 400 days.

fields.label: Overall Business Health
fields.description: The plain average of the questions scored that day, as a percentage; empty when none could be scored.

fields.label: Questions
fields.description: JSON: for each question's figure (score_deliver, score_paid, ...), its score that day and its state (live, needs_setup, no_access, unreachable, failed).

fields.label: Vital Signs
fields.description: JSON: the Executive Summary's daily vital signs -- for each of ar_total, ap_total and stock_value, its value that day and its state -- so the summary can say what changed on last week (command_center.health.record_vitals). Empty on a day they were not read.

name: Command Center Health Snapshot
